facts.label: Agora e frequência
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para agora: I’m watering the plants. Use always, usually e never para hábitos: I usually water it on Sundays.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m watering the plants. He’s digging a hole. What are you doing? Use now para reforçar.

facts.label: Frequência
facts.sub: Para hábitos, use o present simples com always, usually, often e never: I always water them. Coloque esses advérbios antes do verbo principal.

pages.title: A sunny yard · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a sunny yard in Wellington. The air is fresh and quiet. Noah stands next to a row of green plants. A hose lies on the grass. His neighbor Jonas looks over the wall. He asks about the plants.
“Hi, Noah! What are you doing in the yard?” says Jonas. “I’m watering the plants. I always water them in the morning.” says Noah. “They look happy. Are you watering the grass, too?” says Jonas.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: O -ing soa “ing” fraco. Em watering, diga “uóte-rin”. O g quase some.
pages.tip: Compare water e watering: o final muda.

solo: Modele, peça repetição, depois uso livre.
group: Foco: -ing no fim. Diga watering como “uóte-rin”.
Coro, depois um a um; ouça sem corrigir tudo.
extra90: Cada aluno grava um áudio de 10 segundos e compara com o modelo.
